correctness.rationale: Rooted-forest enumeration gives (d+1)n^(n−d−2) trees per prescribed path; deleting r off-path and s endpoint leaves leaves (d+1−s)(n−r−s)^(n−d−2) admissible trees. Multiplication by binomial choices gives exact mixed binomial moments and full PGF; first moments yield mean and difference sign 2(n−1)−d(d+1)^2, with fixed-distance and d=n−1 boundaries handled. Independent Prüfer exhaustive checks n=3..6 reproduce moments, optimum and n=3 boundary. Gaussian distance tails justify the claimed Rayleigh-scale covariance asymptotic; finite sampling alone was not used as proof.
